tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Implement the approved portable CIS-owned metric definitions, finite units/string dimensions, counter/up-down/gauge/histogram/timer/observable semantics as thin BCL adapters. Stable registrations reuse handles, incompatible translated definitions fail, invalid recordings drop with bounded diagnostics, timer first Stop/Dispose fixes exactly one attempt. Establish host-owned Meter/attachment and actual callback admission/drain seams preserving existing constructors/pre-DI services, disabled behavior and Core closure; no aggregate engine/global latest-provider. Own portable contracts/fixtures, meaningful tests/docs/review and freeze APIs/catalog before dependent work.

tasks.validation: Native independent values and BCL listener cases for MET01/02 and A01-04: numeric semantics, timer race and invalid completion no retry, schema/name/translated child collisions and bounded capacity/invalid-input behavior. Verify public consumer API excludes BCL/SDK instrumentation types, Core dependency closure unchanged and proposed optional binding can use host-owned references.
